description.value: The study evaluated the contribution of 11C-PIB amyloid imaging and 18F-FDG glucose metabolism PET/CT to the assessment of cognitive impairment in the clinical setting.

spans.text: The objective of this study was to evaluate the contribution of amyloid imaging with (11)C-Pittsburgh compound B ((11)C-PIB) and of glucose metabolism on F-fluorodeoxyglucose ((18)F-FDG) PET/CT to the study of cognitive impairment in the clinical setting.

description.value: Thirty-four patients with different degrees of cognitive impairment were recruited through the Cognitive Impairment Unit of the hospital and underwent PET/CT imaging and clinical and neuropsychological evaluation.
